args.subject: Sushi-making workshop!
args.body:
Hi Jack,

I wanted to share that I recently attended a sushi-making workshop at the Japanese Cultural Center and I was particularly proud of the spicy tuna roll I made!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Restaurant Recommendation: The Rustic Kitchen
args.body:
Hi Henry,

I wanted to recommend a restaurant I visited last night called "The Rustic Kitchen" on Oak Street. I had a delightful experience there—the ambiance was cozy and the truffle risotto was absolutely mouthwatering. It's definitely worth checking out!

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Weekend trip to the countryside
args.body:
Hi Alice,

I wanted to share some details about my recent weekend trip to the countryside with my best friend Sarah. We had a wonderful time exploring charming little towns, hiking in the lush forests, and enjoying a relaxing break away from the city.

Best,
[Your Name]

args.subject: Stargazing in the mountains
args.body: Hi Grace, I wanted to share a highlight from my recent mountain trip with my childhood friend Emily. One of the best parts was going stargazing at night—it was a perfect way to unwind and connect with nature.

args.subject: New favorite wine discovery
args.body: Hi Jack, I wanted to share that I discovered a new favorite Merlot at a wine tasting event last Saturday. I absolutely loved it!
